faq.title: Got a question?
faq.subtitle: Can't find your answer? Message us on WhatsApp and we'll get back to you quickly.

items.a: Usually the cleaning fee is added to the guest's booking on the platforms, so it doesn't come out of your pocket. On the Cleaning-only package it's charged per visit based on unit size — all spelled out in the contract.

items.q: How do I receive my earnings?
items.a: We transfer your net income to your bank account on a [periodic/monthly] basis, along with a detailed report of every booking, revenue and expense — no surprises.

items.q: Can I use my apartment whenever I want?
items.a: Of course. Tell us the dates you want for yourself or family and we'll block them on every platform so there are no conflicts.

We inspect and photo-document the unit after every guest. If there's damage, we pursue the claim with the guest or the platform's host protection program. Responsibilities are clearly set out in the contract.

Renting residential units to visitors requires a license from the Ministry of Tourism. We help you understand the requirements and prepare the unit, and always recommend checking the latest rules through the Ministry's official channels.
The contract term is [term], renewable, with the option to end it with [notice period] notice. We want you to stay because you're happy, not because you're locked in.

about.title: Started in Abha, for Abha
about.intro: [Draft copy — edit] Clees is a simple idea: many owners have furnished apartments that could earn great income, but no time to manage bookings, cleaning and guests. And many visitors look for a clean, reliable apartment and struggle to find one. We connect the two.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how [Company legal name] ("Clees", "we") collects, processes and protects your personal data when you use our website and services, in accordance with the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and its Implementing Regulations.

sections.title: 1. Data we collect
body: Data you provide directly: name, mobile number, email, unit details (neighborhood, bedrooms, furnishing) and any notes you send.
Limited technical data such as IP address and browser type, used for security and abuse prevention.
Analytics data (if enabled) via tools such as Google Analytics or Meta Pixel, only once activated and in compliance with applicable law.

sections.title: 2. Purposes of processing
body: Contacting you about your evaluation request or inquiry.
Providing our services and performing contracts with you.
Improving our website and services.
Complying with legal requirements.

sections.title: 3. Legal basis
body: We process your data based on your consent, to perform a contract you are party to, for a legitimate interest that does not override your rights, or to meet a legal obligation.

sections.title: 4. Sharing data
body: We do not sell your personal data.
We may share limited data with service providers acting on our behalf (such as email delivery and hosting) under contractual obligations to protect it.
We may disclose data where legally required by a competent authority.

sections.title: 5. Transfers outside the Kingdom
body: Some data may be processed by providers outside the Kingdom; in that case we comply with the PDPL controls and the Regulation on Personal Data Transfer outside the Kingdom.

sections.title: 6. Retention
body: We keep data only as long as needed for the purpose it was collected for, or as required by law, then securely destroy it.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
body: The right to be informed about how your data is collected and processed.
The right to access your data and obtain a copy.
The right to request correction or updating of your data.
The right to request destruction of your data once no longer needed.
The right to withdraw your consent at any time.

sections.title: 8. Security
body: We apply appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, loss or leakage.

sections.title: 9. Contact
body: For any question or request regarding your personal data, email us at {email}. You may also lodge a complaint with the competent authority (Saudi Data & AI Authority, SDAIA).

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By using the Clees website you agree to the following terms. Please read them carefully.

sections.title: 1. About the website
body: This website is owned by [Company legal name], Commercial Registration No. [CR number], and presents furnished-unit management and cleaning services and receives evaluation requests.

sections.title: 2. Information & estimates
body: Figures shown in the income estimator are preliminary and for illustration only; they are not a guarantee of any income.
Prices and packages may change; the signed contract between the parties is the final reference.

sections.title: 3. Bookings
body: Guest bookings are made through third-party platforms (such as Airbnb, Gathern and Booking) and are subject to those platforms' terms and cancellation/refund policies.

sections.title: 4. Acceptable use
body: You may not use the website for any unlawful purpose, submit false information, or attempt to harm or disrupt the website.

sections.title: 5. Intellectual property
body: All content, logos and designs on the website belong to Clees and may not be used without prior written permission.

sections.title: 6. Limitation of liability
body: We strive to keep information accurate but are not liable for decisions made on it without consulting us.

sections.title: 7. External links
body: The website may contain links to external sites whose content and policies we do not control.

sections.title: 8. Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and the competent courts of the Kingdom have jurisdiction over any dispute.

sections.title: 9. Changes & contact
body: We may update these terms from time to time; the version published on this page applies. Contact: {email}.
